scope: One fixed but uncertain RC mode in the conditional integer battery provider. Continuous real resistance/time-constant values inside a declared box; other modes, R0 and encoded OCV remain known. No drift, hysteresis or uncertain current/time in this milestone.

inherits.rule: Original source and evidence stay byte-identical. New provider adapts certificate003 with explicit lineage; all inherited assumptions apply except the selected known-R/tau premise replaced below.

model.units: Current microA, R milliohm, voltage and RC state nV, time ticks at35000Hz; I_microA*R_milliohm gives nV. Q microAh. Physical SOC z is a fraction; stored SOC coordinates x=65536*z.
model.input_order: Actual intervals once in acquisition order; current is constant within each interval and voltage is measured at its endpoint. Nominal35Hz does not replace actual intervals.
model.uncertain_mode: For each mode, R lies in [r_lower_mOhm,r_upper_mOhm] and tau_ticks in [tau_lower_ticks,tau_upper_ticks]. At most one mode has unequal endpoints in either coordinate; zero uncertain modes is admitted for degeneration tests. A mode with both uncertain R and tau counts once.
model.continuum: Actual R and tau can be real between the encoded integer endpoints. They are fixed across the entire certified episode and need not be grid points.
model.common_domains: Every immutable capacity cell crosses the common initial-SOC interval, initial-RC box and fixed RC parameter box. Q and z0 are static. SOC stays in[0,1].
model.observation_premise: Each supplied voltage interval contains the exact terminal voltage for the complete static configuration. The declared hard bound is not justified by a Gaussian sigma or prior local precision.
model.box_validity: The uncertain box is supplied before initialization and stays immutable. Enlarging, moving or recentering it after exclusions requires a separate history/transport proof and is not authorized by this API.

machine_ranges.current: int32 input with configured absolute limit<=200000 microA
machine_ranges.state: Integer endpoints inside[-B,B],0<=B<=2^30 nV; configuration requires current_limit*Rhi<=B for every mode
machine_ranges.force_product: Both I*R endpoint products are formed in int64, ordered by sign and range-checked before int32 conversion; magnitude<=200000000 nV
machine_ranges.attenuation: Q32 interval with0<=Alo<=Ahi<=D=2^32, inherited outward endpoint kernel
machine_ranges.corner_arithmetic: Inherited corner magnitude<=D*B<=2^62; no new runtime product exceeds the frozen scalar-kernel range
machine_ranges.charge_and_query: Same exact int64 net-charge limit2^44, SOC ratio/PWL inverse ranges and outward target operations as certificate003
machine_ranges.width_certificate_arithmetic: The symbolic width numerator may exceed fixed-width integer ranges in a generic domain. The audit evaluates it using arbitrary-precision Python integers/Fraction; it is not computed by the bounded C provider.

new_primitives.attenuation_box: Validate positive ordered tau endpoints. Lower endpoint is the frozen attenuation lower certificate at tau_lo; upper endpoint is the frozen upper certificate at tau_hi. Equal tau endpoints use the frozen kernel once. No assumption that rounded kernel outputs are monotone is needed for soundness.
new_primitives.forcing_interval: T=[min(I*Rlo,I*Rhi),max(I*Rlo,I*Rhi)]; negative current reverses endpoint order.
new_primitives.state_step: Use two copies of the SAME original state. Apply frozen point-target interval step at Tlo and Thi; select lower endpoint from Tlo and upper endpoint from Thi because1-a>=0. Singleton forcing may use the old step directly.
new_primitives.atomicity: Negative errors leave destination state/coefficient unchanged. Validate state, coefficient and BOTH target endpoints/order before exact-unity no-write identity. No floats, libm, heap or lifetime counter.

width_theorem.definitions: W=state interval diameter, F=target interval diameter, D=2^32; state and all targets lie in[-B,B].
width_theorem.one_step: W_next <= (Ahi*W+(D-Alo)*F+2B*(Ahi-Alo))/D+2; exact[Alo,Ahi]=[D,D] instead leaves W unchanged with no rounding term.
width_theorem.future_premise: A certified future active alphabet or other uniform proof supplies g>0 with Ahi<=D-g, b>=D-Alo and h>=Ahi-Alo for every active update; F<=Fmax. Arbitrarily many validated exact identities may intervene.
width_theorem.all_prefix: W_n <= min(2B,max(W0,(b*Fmax+2B*h+2D)/g)) for every finite prefix.
width_theorem.parameter_and_rounding_terms: b*Fmax/g is the resistance-forcing contribution;2B*h/g includes time-constant ambiguity and coefficient enclosure error;2D/g is the endpoint-rounding allowance. h is not purely numerical when tau is uncertain.
width_theorem.failure_of_contraction_premise: Without a certified positive g, the refined width bound is unavailable. Convex-domain containment and the2B bound still hold; finite observed contraction cannot replace the future premise.

evidence_and_query.representation: Up to64 immutable closed capacity bins with monotonically contracting integer SOC0 intervals; shared3RC outer intervals, exact net charge and monotone active mask. Full backing configuration is counted.
evidence_and_query.compatible_set: F_n contains full static configurations (R_uncertain,tau_uncertain,z0,Q,initial_RC) consistent with every observation and the physical-domain constraints through n.
evidence_and_query.retention: Every point of F_n survives in EVERY original capacity cell containing its Q, including overlapping and shared-boundary cells; its SOC0 remains inside that cell's retained strip.
evidence_and_query.targets: Same persistent outward currentSOC and capacity hulls as certificate003. Equal-charge nonwidening and no reappearing excluded cell. CurrentSOC width can grow when net charge changes.
evidence_and_query.uncertain_parameters: The supplied R/tau box is not contracted. They remain unresolved within that box; no nuisance-parameter learning claim.
evidence_and_query.correlation_limit: Shared interval propagation forgets parameter-state and cross-time correlations. It can admit fictitious time-varying nuisance choices and other false positives while remaining sound for every fixed actual parameter pair. Nonempty outer support does not prove exact feasibility.

transaction_and_availability.transaction: Same whole-bank caller-owned staging as003. Negative status leaves the bank unchanged and does not propagate the sample. Valid contradiction commits charge/RC evolution and sticky empty support.
transaction_and_availability.availability_corollary: For actual Q<=100000 microAh and true z0,z_n in[0,1], |P_n|<=12600000000000<2^44. New target validation and convex interval propagation preserve the same state/range invariants. A true compatible static configuration retains support; every admitted finite-prefix push returns OK, independently of age/total absolute throughput.
transaction_and_availability.execution_premises: Trusted initialized objects, valid disjoint bank/config/sample/workspace/output storage, immutable live configuration, conforming exact-width C99 integer semantics, no concurrent mutation or hardware faults, and caller-supplied admitted chronology.

conditional_nominal_comparison.premises: Same original capacity cells, SOC0 prior, known R0/OCV, represented input scales/current/time, starting RC intervals and domains. A represented fixed nominal R/tau point is admitted by its own configuration and lies in the box. Both streams have numerically admitted pushes. Its computed attenuation enclosure is a subset of the box enclosure for every admitted future tick; finite alphabet enumeration certifies this extra numerical premise.
conditional_nominal_comparison.claim: At every prefix, nominal RC intervals, active-cell support and meaningful SOC0/query outer sets are contained in boxed support. SOC0 strip inclusion is claimed only for active nominal cells; frozen fields of excluded cells have no support semantics. A nominal empty set is trivially contained. No positive contraction margin is needed for this nesting theorem.
conditional_nominal_comparison.scope: Soundness for the full continuous parameter box is U1-U5 and does not depend on this comparison premise.

reference_coordinate_mapping.reason: Frozen3RC reference slowtau support ends at30s, below part of the predeclared uncertainty box. Preserve the old core and use an explicitly declared public unit transformation in the new comparison harness.
reference_coordinate_mapping.identities: dt'/tau'=dt/tau, I'R'=IR and I' dt'=I dt preserve exact model predictions and objective. This is a real-arithmetic identity, not a floating-point bitwise-equivalence theorem.
reference_coordinate_mapping.supports: Free reference slowtau maps to physical[3,60]s and R to[0,2]ohm, broader than provider[27,33]s/[.054,.066]ohm. Q prior is unchanged. Known physical taus .05/.5 map to .025/.25 within frozen solver bounds.
reference_coordinate_mapping.starts_and_reporting: Use predeclared public solver-coordinate starts; their physical tau values change with the unit map and contain no truth. Convert fit tau,R and elapsed time back by2. Raw scaled resistance coordinate R'/.2 is physicalR/.4; raw Gram is local, not coverage or marginal SOC/Q precision.

proof_kind: Written source-level mathematics and independent review; not proof-assistant, compiler or Cortex-M23 certification. Finite audits can falsify correspondence but do not supply the all-prefix quantifier.
open: Complete target resources and arithmetic qualification
